rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is impressive.

example.english: The desserts at this restaurant are really impressive.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲甜品真係厲害。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 tim4 ban2 zan1 hai6 lai6 hoi6

rows.note: Use this for enthusiastic casual praise, especially of someone's performance or ability.

example.english: You can play this song so well at such a young age—impressive!
example.traditional: 你咁後生就識彈呢首歌，犀利喎！
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 sik1 taan4 ni1 sau2 go1 sai1 lei6 wo3

rows.note: Use this when the thing makes a particularly powerful emotional or visual impact.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 git3 guk6 zan1 hai6 hou2 zan3 ham6

rows.note: Use this when the impressive quality is mainly someone's stylish, striking, or charismatic appearance.

example.english: They walked in wearing a suit and looked really impressive.
example.traditional: 佢着住套西裝行入嚟，真係好有型。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 tou3 sai1 zong1 haang4 jap6 lei4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 jing4
